name: Crossing the Lines
source:
You play Emily, a 22-year-old student struggling with money problems, studies, friendships, romantic relationships, and the weight of unspoken family secrets. Torn between loyalty and temptation, love and sex, she must navigate a world where every choice will change her future.

[From F95Zone]
